items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Leo Dixon was working for Chappelle(?)... I could get a ticket to any show that they had music on.

ctx.x: They used to give you all kinds of gifts, like pots and pans...

And I could go to any show that Chapelle(?) had. Leo Dixon was working for Chappelle(?)... I could get a ticket to any show that they had music on. I never paid to go see none of them shows. And I just got close to them, and I was their boy. And I found out if they got a song on the air five times during that night, they almost had a hit. They were the ones that I just learned if you play a song long enough, people will catch on to it.
